How you could lose money
If the business stops earning, you may receive less than you put in.
50% of principal went to the business at activation; the contracts cannot recover it.
The API can divert payTo (the payment recipient) between checks. Detection is expected within about 30 minutes while monitoring works, but is not guaranteed. Its $0.50 stake covers only part of possible losses.
Two qualifying routing violations in adjacent report epochs, or 24 hours of qualifying unreachable reports while active, can cause default. An outage of the monitor alone does not.
The milestone can still release remaining capital; “revenue stops” assumes it returns to holders instead.
No market: you cannot sell here. Early redemption gives up future receipts.
Monad testnet. These contracts are unaudited; bugs can cause losses.
